text:
maya: Final sprint — can everyone quick-pass the launch post below? Need hero claim, benchmark blurb, and webinar CTA mapping locked by EOD. Copy excerpt + UTMs pasted. TL;DR: keep the hero tight, no absolute latency guarantees, and add a short customer quote placeholder.

tony: Scanning — hero feels a little lofty. Suggest: 'Predictable LLM inference at production scale' instead of 'best-in-class'. shorter and defensible.

elena: +1 on the hero tweak. Also need 2 embed examples under 'When to use' — we have a pagerank + semantic search snippet from the bench team. I can drop a short code sample.

sam: For the webinar CTA: prefer 'Register for the live demo' then 'Get the benchmark guide' as a follow-up auto-email. Do we have the reg link? Also confirm which HubSpot form we'll use.

maya: Reg link is going into hs form id 81234 (marketing flow). Sam can you/ops confirm utm params? I'll include them now.

maya: UTM mapping (please copy into the blog CTA button href):
``` 
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=redwood-launch-2026&utm_content=cta-demo
```

tony: Legal note — avoid 'zero downtime' and 'always available' phrasing. Use 'designed for high availability' instead.

jane_legal: Quick pass from legal: okay with the benchmark callout if we include the test harness link and a short method note: 'internal lab test on open LLMs, see appendix'. Also remove 'industry-leading' from the hero.

elena: I'll add the embed snippets and the method blurb. Attaching snippet — paste into the doc and I'll tidy formatting.

elena: ```python
# semantic search example
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key='REDACTED')
resp = cli.embeddings.create(['query text'])
```

sam: HubSpot confirm: form 81234 mapped to list 'Launch Webinar 2026'. I'll set the automations: send benchmark guide after registration. When are we locking the publish window?

maya: Publish window targeted Tues 10am PT. Need final signoff by 4pm PT today.

ton y: (typo fix) -> tony: signoff: copy with hero update + legal tweaks is good from content side. :thumbsup:

jane_legal: Legal signoff (quick): ok with final wording per my comment.

elena: Design wants the hero asset by noon — I'll upload the hero image to the assets drive and ping design.

marketing-bot: Calendar reminder set: "Launch post publish — Tue 10:00 PT" added to #marketing calendar. Invite sent to maya, tony, elena, sam.

maya: Great. Final checklist for 4pm signoff: 1) hero line updated (maya/tony) 2) embed examples added (elena) 3) legal notes in appendix (jane_legal) 4) HubSpot reg + UTM wired (sam) 5) hero asset uploaded (elena) 6) webinar CTA/button href verified (sam)

sam: I'll run a quick smoke test on the form + UTM at 2pm and report back here.

maya: Thanks team — I'll do the final copy push to the CMS and ping for approval. If anyone has any blockers, flag them here asap. :rocket:
